textual.observation: The speaker promotes a cryptocurrency certification/program as an “awesome program,” says “anybody can do it” and “free to join,” identifies Craig Grant as a sponsor, and provides referral-style program URLs in the description.

evidence.quote: pretty much wanna talk about the uh, future money program and the cryptocurrency certification that i have
this future money of the program like a say anybody can do it
it's free to join to learn knowledge and gain it
shout out to Craig Grant is my sponsor

textual.context: Promotional and educational context is explicit; the speaker endorses the program and links it to joining, while the records do not clarify whether the URLs provide compensation or what participation involves.
textual.potential_relevance: The promotional endorsement and sponsor claim are connected to an invitation to join and referral-style opportunity URLs, creating a specific audience-action/destination relationship for later context assessment.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish any monetary return, fee, referral compensation, required payment or transfer, sensitive-data request, identity verification, transaction outcome, or actual audience participation.

textual_context_notes.observation: The speaker frames the program as educational instruction about cryptocurrency, including what it is, how it works, and peer-to-peer transactions, and describes joining as free.

evidence.quote: the cryptocurrency program teaches you about cryptocurrency what it is and what it does and how you use it
it's free to join to learn knowledge and gain it

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because the speaker promotes Future Money as a cryptocurrency program, names a sponsor, invites viewers to join, and directs viewers to Bitconnect and a Future Money opportunity URL with the same referral-style identifier. The material does not establish referral compensation, required payment, promised returns, or an audience transaction, and a displayed BCC receiving address is not linked to joining.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The speaker's stated sponsor relationship and the referral-style opportunity links provide the best-supported evidence of recruitment-oriented promotion. The evidence does not establish commissions, downlines, matrices, slots, or tier qualification, so the fit to the full S06 definition remains partial.
